entities.summary: The Church of the Holy Trinity is a Roman Catholic church in Hyervyaty, Grodno Region, Belarus. It is an example of the Belarusian Neogothic architecture and was built in 1899–1903. The church is a site of cultural heritage of Belarus. Church of the Holy Trinity in Gierviaty is a Catholic church building in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
